headline: Give reporting a clear starting point
subtext: The public Hush Line Directory gathers contact channels in one place, so visitors know where they can begin if they have a concern to report.
image_alt_text: Light-mode social graphic headed “Give reporting a clear starting point” beside the Hush Line public Directory. The screen shows a Tor Browser reminder, the Verified tab, tabs for several kinds of recipients, a Search verified users field, a verification note, and a profile card. The graphic illustrates the principle that a whistleblowing system needs an available place to begin.

social.bluesky:
Reporting needs a clear starting point. Hush Line’s public Directory gathers contact channels for lawyers, journalists, and people supporting whistleblowers. Use the tabs or Search verified users. Sending a message does not require registration.

Bookmark it: https://tips.hushline.app/directory
social.linkedin:
A whistleblowing system needs a clear starting point.

One plain ISO 37002 principle is this: reporting must be possible and easy to begin. Hush Line’s public Directory gathers contact channels for lawyers, journalists, and people supporting whistleblowers. Visitors can explore the tabs or use Search verified users.

They can send a message; no registration or app download is required.

Bookmark the Directory so you know where to find it later: https://tips.hushline.app/directory
social.mastodon:
A whistleblowing system needs a clear starting point.

ISO 37002 calls for reporting to be encouraged and facilitated. In plain terms, the path has to be available. Hush Line’s public Directory gathers contact channels for lawyers, journalists, and people supporting whistleblowers. Visitors can explore the tabs or use Search verified users.

Bookmark the Directory: https://tips.hushline.app/directory

rationale: The required Directory screenshot is a cooldown fallback, so this plan avoids the recent recipient-review, verification, and role-selection angles. It uses the ISO 37002 principle of making reporting available and easy to begin, with a fresh hook about providing a starting point and a bookmark-for-later CTA. The copy stays public-facing and connects the visible Directory tabs and search field to a concrete benefit for someone who may need to report a concern.
copy_brief: Write for sources and public users evaluating or using Hush Line.

editorial_intent.label: Public sources and visitors
editorial_intent.reader_need: Help someone decide whether Hush Line is the right place to make safe first contact or find a trusted recipient.
